job.question: In the Baltimore City Employees' Retirement Systems (BCERS) RFP for an alternatives consultant, how many years must the proposing firm have been in business?
job.expected_facts: At least seven (7) years providing general consulting services plus private equity consulting services, or alternatives consulting services only (all minimum qualifications must be met as of November 8, 2024, 3:00 p.m. EDT).
job.acceptance: Seven years is sufficient for the narrow question. Service type and qualification deadline are optional; five-year staff experience is not the firm threshold.

reviews.reason: This is a 2020 Temple City RFP for plan administration and recordkeeping, not the BCERS alternatives-consultant RFP. Its five-year firm-experience minimum concerns administering governmental 457 plans; its seven-year references concern optional contract pricing, not years in business.
quotes: City of Temple City, California 457 Deferred Compensation Plan Request for Proposals for Plan Administration and Record Keeping Services
RFP DISTRIBUTION DATE: June 17, 2020 at 4:00 PM (Pacific Time)
The Proposing Firm must have a minimum of five (5) years of experience administering governmental Section 457 deferred compensation plans
any seven- and ten-year pricing offers carry an assumption that the Plan Sponsor extends its contract
